python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd,numpy as np,re
from collections import defaultdict
from sklearn.ensemble import ExtraTreesRegressor,RandomForestRegressor,HistGradientBoostingRegressor
from sklearn.gaussian_process import GaussianProcessRegressor
from sklearn.gaussian_process.kernels import ConstantKernel,Matern,WhiteKernel
from sklearn.kernel_ridge import KernelRidge
from sklearn.model_selection import KFold,cross_val_predict
from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error
D=pd.read_csv('b3_supercon_target.csv')
rows=[]
for s in D.composition:
 d=defaultdict(float)
 for e,v in re.findall(r'([A-Z][a-z]*)([0-9]*\.?[0-9]*)',s):d[e]+=float(v or 1)
 n=sum(d.values());rows.append({e:v/n for e,v in d.items()})
X=pd.DataFrame(rows).fillna(0);y=D.target.values
print('Rows:',len(D),'Elements:',len(X.columns))
print('High-temperature rows:')
print(D[y>=40].to_string(index=False))
models={
 'ET':ExtraTreesRegressor(n_estimators=500,min_samples_leaf=1,max_features=1.,random_state=17,n_jobs=-1),
 'RF':RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=500,min_samples_leaf=1,max_features=1.,random_state=17,n_jobs=-1),
 'GPR':GaussianProcessRegressor(kernel=ConstantKernel(1.,(.01,100))*Matern(length_scale=.3,length_scale_bounds=(.03,3),nu=1.5)+WhiteKernel(.03,(1e-4,1)), normalize_y=True,n_restarts_optimizer=3,random_state=17)
}
cv=KFold(n_splits=5,shuffle=True,random_state=17)
for name,m in models.items():
 p=cross_val_predict(m,X,y,cv=cv)
 print(name,'CV MAE=',round(mean_absolute_error(y,p),2),'CV MAE(y>=40)=',round(mean_absolute_error(y[y>=40],p[y>=40]),2))
 m.fit(X,y)
 if name=='GPR':print(m.kernel_)

def features(s):
 d=defaultdict(float)
 for e,v in re.findall(r'([A-Z][a-z]*)([0-9]*\.?[0-9]*)',s):d[e]+=float(v or 1)
 n=sum(d.values());return [d[e]/n for e in X.columns]
candidates=['Y1Ba2Cu3O7','Y1Ba2Cu2.99Zn0.01O7','Y1Ba2Cu3O6.9','Bi2Sr2Ca1Cu2O8','Bi2Sr2Ca1Cu2O9','Bi2Sr2Ca1Cu2O10','Bi2Sr2Ca0.7Y0.3Cu2O8','Bi2Sr2Ca0.7Y0.3Cu2O10','Bi2Sr2Ca0.9Y0.1Cu2O10','Bi2Sr2Ca0.8Y0.2Cu2O10']
C=pd.DataFrame([features(s) for s in candidates],columns=X.columns)
for i,s in enumerate(candidates): print(s, {n:round(float(m.predict(C.iloc[[i]])[0]),2) for n,m in models.items()})
import pickle
with open('/tmp/supercon_models.pkl','wb') as f:pickle.dump((D,X,y,models),f)
PY

python - <<'PY'
import pickle,re,numpy as np,pandas as pd
from sklearn.ensemble import ExtraTreesRegressor
from sklearn.model_selection import KFold,cross_val_predict
from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error
with open('/tmp/supercon_models.pkl','rb') as f:D,X,y,models=pickle.load(f)
os=np.linspace(7,10,601)
A=pd.DataFrame(0.,index=range(len(os)),columns=X.columns)
for e,v in [('Bi',2),('Sr',2),('Ca',1),('Cu',2)]:A[e]=v/(7+os)
A['O']=os/(7+os)
p=[]
for seed in [17,42,123,2026,314]:
 m=ExtraTreesRegressor(n_estimators=1000,max_features=1.,random_state=seed,n_jobs=-1).fit(X,y)
 p.append(m.predict(A))
p=np.array(p)
mean=p.mean(axis=0); ix=np.argmin(abs(mean-90))
print('Best O stoichiometry:',os[ix],'prediction:',mean[ix],'seed predictions:',p[:,ix])
for o in [7,7.5,7.8,7.9,8,8.5,9,10]:
 i=np.argmin(abs(os-o));print(o,'mean',mean[i],'std',p[:,i].std())
print('Proposed fractions:', A.iloc[ix][A.iloc[ix]>0].to_dict())
PY
